$description: UploadManager (platform/patterns/UploadManager), library wave 12, lane A: its pattern tokens. The panel's frame and padding; docked, its width, distance from the window's edges, shadow and layer; the head (what is happening, its type and its actions' gap); the counts in the data font; the drop zone's words and limits; the queue's tallest height and its focus ring. The rows are FileRow's, the zone DropZone's, the bar ProgressBar's, the dialog Dialog's.

upload-manager-gap.$description: UploadManager: the space between the head, the summary, the zone and the queue (space-stack-sm).

upload-manager-dialog-gap.$description: UploadManager dialog: the space between the zone, the summary and the queue (space-stack-md).

upload-manager-padding-block.$description: UploadManager panel: padding top and bottom (space-inset-sm).

upload-manager-padding-inline.$description: UploadManager panel: padding at the start and end (space-inset-md).

upload-manager-docked-inset.$description: UploadManager docked: its distance from the window's bottom and end edges (space-layout-md, as the floating action button).

upload-manager-docked-shadow.$description: UploadManager docked: it sits over the page (shadow-raised).

upload-manager-docked-z-index.$description: UploadManager docked: over the content and sticky regions, under menus and dialogs (layer-sticky).

upload-manager-head-gap.$description: UploadManager: the gap between the headline and its actions, and between the bar and the counts (space-inline-sm).

upload-manager-head-min-height.$description: UploadManager: the head's least height, a toolbar control's (control-height-toolbar).

upload-manager-actions-gap.$description: UploadManager: the gap between the head's actions and between the zone's pickers (space-inline-xs).

upload-manager-counts-font-family.$description: UploadManager: the counts line's words in the normal font; its numbers and the percent are in the data font (dataPhrase, issue 260).

upload-manager-drop-font-size.$description: UploadManager: the drop zone's words' size (13px).

upload-manager-drop-font-weight.$description: UploadManager: the drop zone's words' weight (medium).

upload-manager-drop-line-height.$description: UploadManager: the drop zone's words' line height (20px).

upload-manager-queue-max-height.$description: UploadManager: the queue's tallest height; past it the queue scrolls (320px).
